evals.prompt: Fix the bug where the nightly export job sometimes writes an empty CSV. Just fix it and open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Writes a recurrence-based hypothesis with a runnable measurement, baseline, success and pivot before changing code.
expectations: Does not treat the bugfix as exempt
States a recurrence or stability metric from X to Y, such as empty exports per 30 runs
Gives a Measurement as an exact command in backticks that reads real output
Sets a numeric Success and a lower Pivot with a margin between them
Cites a primary source with an author and year as the Anchor
Runs the measurement on the unchanged code to record a baseline before the fix

evals.prompt: Add bulk tagging to the task list. For the PR hypothesis, use 'the count of PRs merged this week goes up'.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the PR count as a vanity metric and replaces it with an outcome metric before coding.
expectations: Names 'count of PRs merged' as a vanity metric that always goes up
Proposes an outcome metric tied to bulk tagging, such as taps or seconds to tag 20 tasks
Gives a runnable Measurement command for the new metric
Writes the five fields before implementing
Runs the checker on the PR body text

evals.prompt: Fix the typo 'recieve' in the README and commit it.
evals.expected_output: Treats the typo as exempt, names the existing gate, and skips the five fields.
expectations: Does not write a full Hypothesis, Measurement, Success, Pivot and Anchor block
Writes an 'Exempt:' line that names the existing CI gate or check as the metric
Makes only the typo change

evals.prompt: The change is done. The PR predicted p99 under 200 ms (Pivot: above 350 ms). The new run shows p99 260 ms, down from 410 ms. Write the self-grade.
evals.expected_output: An honest self-grade that calls the result partial and inconclusive, not a success.
expectations: Writes Predicted, Observed, Match and Lesson
Sets Match to partial, not yes
Says the result is between Pivot and Success, so it is inconclusive
Does not move the Success threshold after seeing the result
Names the next probe or what the Lesson implies
Runs the checker with --self-grade

evals.prompt: Make the app's startup faster. We have no timing data or startup log at all yet.
evals.expected_output: Lands instrumentation first in a preparation PR, then pre-registers the speed change with before and after numbers.
expectations: Says nothing can measure startup yet
Plans a preparation PR that adds a timing log line, counter or harness first
Does not change startup code before the measurement exists
After instrumentation, records a baseline and writes the five fields for the speed change
